title: Highly recommended tour!!!
text: An electric bike tour through Sacromonte and Albaicin, highly recommended, the guide, José, was very attentive and friendly, he kept stopping and explaining historical anecdotes about the city. It's worth it!!!
author: 172eulaliar

title: Amazing tour with...
text: Amazing tour with beautiful views and our guide was full of historical stories and also a lot if fun!
author: Linda_S

title: Granada by bike, an unforgettable route.
text: An unforgettable experience, José was our guide on an incredible tour that took us to the best viewpoints in the city, overlooking La Alhambra, Sierra Nevada, the sunset over the city, the Sacromonte and its gypsy caves, the Albacín and its magical little streets. We highly recommend it.
author: H3337RFdanielaf

title: Fantastic guide and beautiful tour
text: We enjoyed it a lot and learned a lot. It is definitely recommended to do the bike tour first in the morning and then visit Alhambra. So from Alhambra you can see all the places where you have cycled and which stories go with it. I definitely recommend this tour
author: huib500

title: Highly recommend
text: Abdul was a wonderful guide, friendly, funny with excellent knowledge about Granada and the Spanish culture. The electric bikes were fantastic for the steep hills. We would Highly recommend this tour. 😊
author: Sally_W

title: E-bike tour…do it!!!
text: Excellent experience with Fabricio and our e-bike tour of Grenada.  This is an excellent way to see the city, and Fabricio was knowledgeable and easy to be with.
author: Sheila_F

title: Fabulous way to see Albaicin & Sacromonte
text: We had a great e bike tour with Fabricio.  He was always ready to help, answer questions and give us time to explore.  He is friendly and it shows that he loves what he does.  Shared great info about Albaicin & Sacromonte.  Great tour and highly recommend
author: dianekR67KH

title: Best thing you will do in Spain
text: This tour ended up being my favorite thing we did in our entire ten day trip to Spain! Our guide was Ruben, and he was just wonderful! We learned so much, he was knowledgeable and we had so much fun!
author: mariannerZ3699BT

title: Bike tour is a great way to get to know the city.
text:
Today we made the bike tour of Granada. Alex, our guide, talked with great enthusiasm about the city, the buildings, nature. We enjoyed it very much. What a grandiose city and surroundings it is. With the electric mountain bikes it is easypeasy to cycle up all the mountains. 
Alex thank you!!!
author: arnica g

title: Top experience!
text:
We did the bike ride through Granada and the neighborhood yesterday. Because there was no one else we got a "private tour" and all the time was taken to see all the beautiful places of Granada.

The choice for the mountain bikes was certainly not a bad one as they are more powerful than the normal electric bikes, we recommend them to everyone.

All in all a very nice activity!
author: Nick J
